verdict.rationale: Mercury versions its API under /api/v1/, its docs hub has a version picker (v1-pre, v1, v2), and a public changelog posts dated change notices with migration guidance. However, the evidence explicitly states that no written deprecation or sunset policy is published anywhere on docs.mercury.com, so only the versioning half of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with notice periods, a stated support window for older versions, and independent corroboration of how version transitions are handled in practice.
